label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark leads U.S. Open
items.text: Wyndham Clark leads the U.S. Open at 6-under par through 4 holes, three shots ahead of Max McGreevy, Matt Fitzpatrick, and Dustin Johnson at 3-under.

items.headline: Jason Day withdraws
items.text: Jason Day withdrew from the U.S. Open due to a back injury, ending his 2026 run early.

items.headline: DeChambeau's 427-yard drive
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau hit a 427-yard drive on the 12th hole at Shinnecock Hills, aided by wind and downhill slope, setting up a birdie in round 1.
